outcome: Postoperative pain (VAS scores at 1, 6, 12, 24, and 48 hours)
Time to first postoperative gas extraction
cohort: Healthy pregnant women undergoing cesarean section
finding: Intraoperative SHPB during cesarean section under general anesthesia significantly reduced postoperative pain in the first hour and decreased analgesic use, but delayed time to first postoperative gas extraction.
